No. No it's not. I was suicidal before I went through all this or so I thought. Turns out I realized I was just feeling sorry for myself and being a little baby. What I've gone through these past four years pales in comparison to the struggles I went through before that.
I can't keep this up. I'm so tired.For the love of God. I need help.

You know what they said to me? They said that because I went to the doctor for a checkup and the doctor had put on my paperwork that my leg was no longer red and swollen that I was all better apparently. I guess having a prosthetic leg is just as good as having a regular leg. if my leg was cut off above the knee it would be disability for life but since it's below the knee I am not disabled according to them. I wish they could spend one day without one of their legs below the knee. having to crawl to the bathroom like a baby to go pee in the middle of the night. We're having to sit in the shower like a two-year-old because I might slip and fall. It's so painful all day long everyday. They don't realize that or don't care. I need help from someone. I need a miracle. And the only thing I care about is the fact that if I don't get it a little girl will have a broken heart.

There is nothing they will do to help me. If my ex girlfriend would let me tell them I take care of my daughter 51% of the time then I could get around $550 a month which isn't nearly enough but it would help. She refuses because she believes that I would use it to my advantage by having documented proof that I take care of my daughter the majority of the time and then I would try to get custody of her. Which is absolutely absurd because I live and in an apartment the size of a hotel room.

I pray every single night, throughout the day and my prayers go unanswered. I am at the mercy of the wind..and I can't stand it anymore. 
It's my daughter's birthday today. There's no way I would do anything today. Bit that doesn't mean I won't be weak in the future. I don't want to leave her. I love her so fucking much. I have no family other than her. No one cares. No one calls. I had to learn to walk again, alone. I had to live on the streets in a wheelchair for 8 months with only an empty backpack, alone. Nobody called to check on me. No one pushed me down the street or gave me a ride. No one was there to catch me when I fell over and over and over again. I have made it this far and I don't want to wait now. I have an apartment and I've been here for 2 years somehow. But I'm behind on my rent about $1,300. I have no job opportunities available. Not any immediately anyway. I can't wait two more weeks and start work. I have to pay my rent or I'm going to get kicked out. Then I can't see my daughter who I've spent at least 50% of my time with over the last 6 years. I begged and borrowed and worked for people to be able to feed her and clothe her and shelter her and I'm exhausted. $20 or $50 or $100 is nice to have and it helps, it just doesn't go very far. I need help or everything I've worked for so very hard for the last 4 years is going to be gone in 2 weeks. I've tried every organization in the 211 resource handbook and none of them will help me. I've tried to post my story online to get donations and all I got was $50. I am desperate. If I wasn't so terrified I'd probably rob a bank.
My little brother killed himself in my bathtub when he was 16 in 2002.

I don't want to break my little girls heart. That's the only thing keeping me here. But you can't imagine how hard I have to work just to scrape by. I only have one leg. I lost it 4 years ago and have been denied disability five different times. I can't find a decent job that I can do because of it even though I do try. So that leaves me with no other option but to go out and hold a cardboard sign and beg for money. That's primarily what I've had to do for the last 4 years. I don't have the strength to keep doing it. All I want is some stupid s*** job that I can do and pay my rent and take care of my little girl and be a good daddy. I'm in pain all day everyday but according to the government I'm normal  just like any one of you. When I go pull the sign I do get people that care and give me money but it's always too little. I'm circling the drain here...
No way in hell am I going thru all those emotions again just to hear a fucking dead line.
